# GitHub Copilot Instructions for OpenFrost

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and the
[specification](../docs/ai-os-project-spec.md) for the authoritative instructions.

The repository currently implements S01–S05: workspace, contracts, persistence,
DPAPI secrets, loopback API/UI, bounded executor, research briefs, project
updates, approval-bound export, and owner-approved memory. S06 weekly planning is
next; S07 release hardening remains. Implement only the assigned item in the
[solo backlog](../backlog/solo-rebuild.md); do not treat planned architecture as
existing implementation.
